about_the_game:
XEOM: Saigon Edition drops you into the bustling heart of Saigon, where you become a motorbike taxi driver zipping through narrow alleys, dodging traffic, picking up passengers, delivering packages, and avoiding all sorts of obstacles!

Key Features:

  • Become a taxi rider In the heart of Sai Gon

  • Take on a variety of delivery missions and earn your keep

  • Purchase upgrades, unlock new riders and keep your bike refueled

  • Dodge oncoming traffic and finesse your way around the many wacky obstacles on Sai Gon roads

  • Discover iconic landmarks: Independence Palace, the glamorous Bui Vien street and Ben Thanh market

content_descriptors.notes: Our game offers a lighthearted, cartoonish driving experience focused on humor and chaos. However, it includes adult-themed characters, occasional strong language, and arcade-style driving with minor crashes. All mature content is presented satirically and non-realistically for humor.
